title: Bluemercury Refreshes Lune+Aster
summary: Bluemercury’s proprietary makeup brand Lune+Aster unveils new multitasking products and a fresh “Beauty, Uncomplicated” approach, marking the start of its broader evolution through 2027.

extraction.key_fact: 블루머큐리의 자체 메이크업 브랜드인 룬앤아스터가 새로운 멀티태스킹 제품들과 간결한 뷰티 접근법을 공개했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Bluemercury’s proprietary makeup brand Lune+Aster unveils new multitasking products and a fresh “Beauty, Uncomplicated” approach, marking the start of its broader evolution through 2027.
